vo_open.text: This hole in the desert has been on fire for over fifty years.

vo.text: The Darvaza gas crater, in Turkmenistan. People call it the Door to Hell.
vo.cap: Turkmenistan. They call it: *the Door to Hell.*

vo.text: It's about seventy meters wide, and thirty meters deep.
It was set on fire to burn off the gas. It was supposed to go out quickly.
vo.cap: Set on fire to *burn off the gas.* It should've gone out *fast.*

vo.text: It didn't. In 2013, one explorer climbed all the way to the bottom.
vo.cap: It didn't. *2013:* one explorer reached *the bottom.*

vo.text: Now, the government is trying to put it out.
vo.cap: Now they're trying to *put it out.*

vo.text: Should they put it out, or keep it burning? Tell me in the comments. And subscribe for more.

cta.q: Put it out, or keep it burning?
